execution.identityHint: A separate workspace for contractors, contracts, payments, planning, and quality.
execution.entryHint: Open the execution workspace — separate from the commercial project page.
execution.planningHint: Coordination, tasks, calendar, and timeline. The classic schedule stays on the work tab of a standard project.

hubDescriptions.contracts: Agreements, work lines, and payment stages on the existing model.
hubDescriptions.payments: Claims, certification, retention, deductions, and payment. Certification is not payment and is not AP.
hubDescriptions.planning: Entry to this project's coordination, tasks, calendar, and timeline.
hubDescriptions.quality: Documents, quality, site, and handover — by permission.

paymentStages.title: Payment stages
paymentStages.hint: Milestone and percentage lines on the existing bill of quantities. Weight and dates, without a second money engine.
paymentStages.emptyDescription: Milestone or percentage lines on an agreement will show up here.

execution.dashboardDescription: Operational counts for this project. Tap a card to open the full list.
execution.financialHint: Visible only to authorized users. Certification is not payment and is not AP.

contractors.pageDescription: Agreements on this project — vendor, trade, and status.
contractors.emptyDescription: Create or activate a subcontract agreement to see it here.
contractors.createHint: Use the global + button and choose “Contractor agreement” to add a subcontract on this project.
contractors.countSummary: {count, plural, one {# subcontractor agreement} other {# subcontractor agreements}}
contractors.portalNone: No contractor portal account linked yet.

overview.description: Contract, schedule, claims, documents, and quality for this agreement.

empty.eventsDescription: Events this contractor is invited to will show up here.
empty.tasksDescription: Tasks assigned to this contractor or agreement will show up here.
empty.claimsDescription: Submissions and certifications for this agreement will show up here.
empty.documentsDescription: Documents shared with this contractor or agreement will show up here.
empty.plansDescription: Drawings published to this contractor will show up here.
empty.rfisDescription: RFIs for this contractor will show up here.
empty.submittalsDescription: Submittals from this contractor will show up here.
empty.inspectionsDescription: Quality inspections for this contractor will show up here.
empty.defectsDescription: Defects for this contractor will show up here.
